results.reasoning: 시차증=temporary(일시적). 서쪽여행=lengthens(길게). 동쪽=more serious cases. → (A)temporary (B)lengthens (C)serious = ②.
not synchronized(동기화X) + varying amounts(다양한) + difficult to adjust(적응 어려움) → synchronized—varying—difficult = ④.
internal clock + do not have the same effect + Traveling east shortens → internal—same—shortens = ①.
③shortens → lengthens. 서쪽 여행은 길게 함(lengthens). 동쪽=shortens. ①temporary, ②referred, ④serious 적절.
④resist → adjust. 생체리듬이 적응(adjust)해야 함. ①occurs, ②varying, ③effect 적절.
②extends → shortens. 동쪽 여행은 단축(shortens). extends는 연장. ①synchronized, ③difficult, ④resulting 적절.
Jet lag is a _____ sleep problem → temporary(일시적). synchronized/internal/serious 부적절.
do not have the same _____ on the body → effect(효과). rhythm/cycle/location 부적절.
more difficult for circadian rhythm to _____ → adjust(적응). lengthen/shorten/vary 부적절.
occurs = happens(일어나다). disappears(반대), prevents(막다), remains(남다) 부적절.
adjust = adapt(적응하다). ignore(무시), create(만들다), destroy(파괴) 부적절.
varying = different(다양한). identical/constant/fixed는 varying의 반대 또는 부적절.
temporary(일시적) ↔ permanent(영구적). brief는 유의어, serious/minor는 다른 범주.
lengthens(길게) ↔ shortens(짧게). extends/increases는 유의어, maintains는 다른 의미.
(A) how much time = 시간의 양. (B) it's time to = ~할 때/시기. → (A)시간의 양 (B)~할 때 = ③.
happening or existing only for a limited period of time = temporary(일시적인). internal/serious/permanent 부적절.
length(명사)→lengthen(동사)+3인칭단수-s = lengthens. Traveling west(3인칭단수) 주어.
synchronize → be + p.p. 수동태 → synchronized. is not synchronized with.
This internal clock is also referred to as the body's _____ → circadian rhythm(생체리듬). time zone/sleep problem/day-night cycle 부적절.
not synchronized with the _____ that you are in → time zone(시간대). 현재 위치의 시간대와 동기화 안 될 때 시차증 발생.
